payload.reason: The evidence provides clear details on how the dataset was collected, including the method of crowdsourcing and the validation process.

claims.text: The data was collected using crowdsourcing, with each speaker recorded saying each wording for each intent twice.
Participants consented to data release and provided demographic information, which is included in the dataset.
The data was validated by a separate set of crowdsourcers who removed unintelligible audios or those containing the wrong phrase.
